title: Brutalist Concrete Ribbon Header – Copper Beam Accents
short_description: Warm concrete gray ribbons with sharp copper structural accents.
long_description: Sleek ribbons sweep like exposed structural beams in warm concrete gray with striking copper accent lines. The muted palette and precise motion evoke brutalist architecture and raw material beauty. Ideal for architecture firms, design studios, and luxury real estate brands.

title: Glass Facade Waves Header – Cool Silver Reflection
short_description: Cool blue-gray waves reflecting light like a glass skyscraper.
long_description: Layered waves in steel blue, silver-gray, and pale ice shift like light reflecting off a modern glass curtain wall. The cool, restrained palette and soft blur create a sense of towering architectural precision. Perfect for corporate headquarters, tech firms, and urban development brands.

title: Geometric Blueprint Shape Trail – Architectural Hexagons
short_description: Precise hexagon trails on deep navy like architectural blueprints.
long_description: Clean hexagonal shapes trace precise paths against a deep midnight navy, evoking the clarity of architectural blueprints and structural engineering diagrams. Pale cyan and white outlines glow with understated elegance. Built for architecture portfolios, engineering firms, and design-forward tech brands.

title: Marble Atrium Fluid Header – Veined Gold and Charcoal
short_description: Fluid marble veins in cream, charcoal, and molten gold.
long_description: Rich fluid motion mimics the veined patterns of polished marble in cream, deep charcoal, and liquid gold. The slow, luxurious flow evokes the grandeur of a classical atrium or modern lobby interior. A refined choice for luxury hospitality, high-end real estate, and interior design firms.

title: Steel Structure Particle Ring – Gunmetal Orbital Design
short_description: Silver particles orbit on dark gunmetal like structural engineering.
long_description: A dense ring of silver-white particles orbits slowly through deep gunmetal space, evoking the precision of structural engineering and steel framework. The tilted orbital plane and tight dispersion create a sense of controlled, calculated beauty. Designed for engineering consultancies, industrial design brands, and modern architecture showcases.

short_description: A dynamic blue fluid background for modern tech interfaces.
